name: Spicy Taco Veggie Ground Lettuce Wraps with Fajita Veggies & Avocado
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, halve, and small dice onion. Place in a medium bowl.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers. Add to the bowl with the onion.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the veggie ground and cook, breaking it apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes.
When the veggie ground is done, add onion, bell pepper, and spices to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies start to soften, 3-4 minutes more.
While the veggies are cooking, cut lime into wedges and set aside for serving.
When the veggies are soft, add water and nutritional yeast to the skillet. Cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce is thickened, 1-2 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, halve and pit avocados; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and slice crosswise into thin half-moons.
Separate the lettuce into leaves. Pile leaves, in stacks of two per wrap, onto plates. Fill each wrap with veggie ground, vegetables, and avocado. Serve with lime wedges and enjoy!
author: Mealime
